relevance.rationale: Identified from its own abstract: a disproof of the Erdos-Szemeredi sum-product conjecture over the reals, by constructing arbitrarily large sets A of algebraic integers in number fields of degree ~ log|A| with max(|A+A|, |AA|) <= |A|^{2-c}, plus analogous constructions over p-adics, finite fields and function fields, and new lower bounds for solution counts of linear equations in multiplicative groups and the unit equation. This is additive combinatorics / analytic number theory. The corpus contains no sum-set, product-set, growth, or Erdos-type combinatorial object -- greps for 'sum-product' across content/, docs/ and computations/ return nothing except the ingestion backlog row that flags this very file as unidentified. Nothing in the derivation chain (Hecke, Markov trace, hyperbolic volume, resurgence, q-difference) touches it. Also resolves a standing corpus bookkeeping item: docs/workplans/2026-06-08-uploaded-paper-results-ingestion-backlog.md lists this file as 'UNVERIFIED -- identify on ingestion'.
